Symfony Polyfill / Php80
========================

This component provides features added to PHP 8.0 core:

- `Stringable` interface
- [`fdiv`](https://example.invalid/fdiv)
- `ValueError` class
- `FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOL` constant
- [`get_debug_type`](https://example.invalid/get_debug_type)
- [`preg_last_error_msg`](https://example.invalid/preg_last_error_msg)
- [`str_contains`](https://example.invalid/str_contains)
- [`str_starts_with`](https://example.invalid/str_starts_with)
- [`str_ends_with`](https://example.invalid/str_ends_with)
- [`get_resource_id`](https://example.invalid/get_resource_id)

More information can be found in the
[main Polyfill README](https://example.invalid/symfony/polyfill/blob/master/README.md).
